remarks: Experience more than just a home, embrace a lifestyle of luxury and convenience in one of Downtown Stamford's most sought after condominiums. This stylish 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom corner unit at The Biltmore offers move-in ready living with an open floor plan, engineered hardwood flooring throughout, and a contemporary kitchen featuring shaker cabinets, granite counters, New LG stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar that opens to the spacious living and dining area, perfect for entertaining. Retreat to the two bedrooms, each complemented by beautifully updated bathrooms and a custom walk-in closet. New HVAC 2025. The Biltmore is a full-service luxury hi-rise with a 24-hour concierge, state-of-the-art fitness center, community room, laundry, shuttle to the train, courtyard, and more. Pet-friendly with garage parking available ($118/month per car) and additional storage. Ideally located near highways, Metro North, UCONN, theaters, restaurants, coffee shops, the farmers market, and just steps from vibrant Bedford Street. Live where it all happens, schedule your showing today!
